Karwa Chauth se Diwali tak banayein 2 aasan mithai: Pista Barfi aur Instant Kalakand! Ghar ki mithai, bina fail
Poonam Devnani ki tried-and-tested recipe, Masala Kitchen par. Dono mithai mein bahut kam ingredients lagte hain.
Pista Barfi: 1 litre doodh aadha ubalkar, do layer (safed + hari) mein set karein
Pista nahi hai? Badam, kaju ya nariyal ke burade se bhi banayein
Instant Kalakand: paneer, milk powder aur malai se, minuton mein taiyar
Barfi lagbhag 1 ghante mein set, kalakand fridge mein 30 min mein
Comment karein — kaunsi mithai aap pehle banayengi, barfi ya kalakand?
